messages:
jamie_csm: Quick heads-up — QBR is locked for Wed 11am PT. Need slide owners, a one-slide renewal risk heatmap, and any enablement asks captured by EOD tomorrow. I uploaded the draft deck to the drive.

alex_am: On it. I can own the renewal risk slide — will add status & next-steps per stakeholder. tagging @sara_exec for exec bullets. :eyes:

morgan_se: I can take the 'performance & infra' slide. will add recent latency/cost KPIs and note the dedicated capacity commit implications.

sara_exec: Thanks. For exec bullets, call out two asks: 1) runway to reduce unit cost by 12% and 2) approval to extend dedicated trial for Meridian. Short bullets only.

jamie_csm: Perfect. Devon — can you capture the enablement checklist and customer feedback updates? Need the list to show in the appendix.

devon_enablement: Yep. I'll add a single slide with: onboarding progress, outstanding enablement tasks, and top 3 product feedback items. Will include owner & ETA for each.

alex_am: Quick question — for the renewal heatmap, do we want to use the red/orange/green lanes or a numerical score? I prefer lanes for exec readability.

morgan_se: Lanes + 1-line rationale. e.g., ORANGE — pending infra cost review w/ engineering.

jamie_csm: Lanes then. Keep rationales to one short sentence. Also add renewal date and ARR footprint.

ops-bot: Reminder — doc uploaded: /drive/QBRs/2412345678_qbr_draft.pptx by jamie_csm at 2026-03-20T16:12:03Z

alex_am: Drafted heatmap and pushed slide. Notes: Meridian shows elevated risk because renewal decision pending executive signoff + unmet success metrics.

sara_exec: I'll prep two talking points for the intro: 1) value delivered this quarter, 2) ask for discrete exec decision and timeline.

devon_enablement: Adding enablement tasks: 1) role-based training (owner: devon_enablement, ETA: Apr 12), 2) API onboarding workshop (owner: jamie_csm, ETA: Apr 5), 3) feedback loop cadence (owner: alex_am, ETA: Apr 1).

jamie_csm: Can everyone confirm slide ownership and if you need data from eng or product by EOD? I'll run a dry run Tue 10am PT.

alex_am: Confirmed for renewal heatmap. Need a short ARR table from finance — cc @morgan_se to get numbers.

morgan_se: Will pull token-level and latency numbers. Need the exact time window — use last 30 days.

sara_exec: Confirmed for exec bullets. no extra data needed.

devon_enablement: Confirmed. Would like the top 3 customer quotes for the feedback slide — can someone paste them here?

jamie_csm: Pasting quick quotes pulled from support threads: "integration took longer than expected", "costs spiked during peak test", "team loves the latency but needs better docs for ops."

alex_am: I'll edit quotes to anonymize and tighten to one line each.

morgan_se: uploaded infra graphs to the deck. filename: 2412345678_infra_charts.png

jamie_csm: Final checklist for dry run Tue 10am PT: 1) Slides updated in drive, 2) owners ready to present 1 slide each, 3) dry run attendees: jamie_csm, alex_am, morgan_se, sara_exec, devon_enablement, 4) run through Q&A and finalize ask slide.

ops-bot: Meeting created: QBR — Meridian, 2026-03-24T10:00:00-07:00 (Dial-in + recording enabled). Organizer: jamie_csm

alex_am: One more — I'll pull the recent NPS snippet and drop under 'customer sentiment' slide.

jamie_csm: Awesome. If anyone slides are blocked, ping me now. Otherwise, update the deck and I’ll schedule the dry run link. :thumbsup:
